deviations.what: onCheckBoxSelect calls toolbar.setActive(selected); the port two-way binds one flag on both CheckBox.selected and OverflowToolbar.active, so the toggle happens roundtrip-free in the model. The CheckBox.select attribute is therefore dropped (structural-diff reports attr missing CheckBox.select).
onToolbarPress shows MessageToast.show('OverflowToolbar is clicked') - a constant text, so it is composed on the client via follow_up_action control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show and needs no round-trip.

Both wires are unverified in a running system: the two-way bound active flag (CheckBox -> OverflowToolbar.active) and the client-composed toast on the OverflowToolbar press. **e2e-verified 2026-08-22** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_424.mjs).
